# Original campaign halo-destruction lens controls

The local JSON contains original owned bytes and stays ignored. The trackable
generator authenticates English OG Xbox TU1.5 `default.xbe`, SHA-256
`21b207e7efdacaf6124a0822837f8be570766a42505057f7fd2d2ba8f409c4fd`, and
`00a_introduction.map`, SHA-256
`5093e2f8ef7f0df41c11c6621bac5785a36f78a1cff3b8b2bc6c14b561c02a28`.
It authenticates the actual effect `EA03088E`, event 1, lens `EA050890` and
bitmap `EA060891`, then runs unchanged complete original `2DB80` and reached
callees for eight declared request inputs. No original instruction, external
service, GPU visibility result, active source clock or live World is replaced.

After source promotion, from the repository root with the owned assets present:

```sh
.tools/python/bin/python tools/generate_campaign_lens_fixture_tu15.py \
  --cache assets/disc/maps/00a_introduction.map \
  --xbe '/home/eric/.local/share/halo2-native/imports/halo2-dlc-927a4b262a57/Halo 2 DLC/content/u5English/default.xbe' \
  --fixture tests/fixtures/campaign_lens_tu15.json \
  --report analysis/campaign-lens-original-reproduction/result.json
```

The generator rejects existing destinations. The native test checks the exact
eight-case shape and original pins, complete GP/SSE/defined flags, original
instruction paths, retained memory, x87 and MXCSR. With the optional opening
cache it also prepares all actual lens bitmap resources before a Renderer
exists, and requires both 128x128 authored destruction flare images.
`campaign_lens_tu15_tests --camera` exercises the actual shared camera adapter
at 640, 1280 and 1920 4:3 dimensions, internal supersampling, wide attachment
dimensions, a scaled subrectangle, old default clip words and an independently
supplied clamped camera range. It also links the old exported multiplayer view
symbols. Missing required local files return 77; corrupt present files fail.

The native particle-composition test separately alternates its legacy gates
with actual externally prepared `20680/20700` source gates and checks that
main collection performs each gate, reset, cull and `40E80` exactly once. These
CPU controls do not establish live occlusion, framebuffer parity, checkpoint
restoration, or higher-resolution Xbox hardware coverage.
